notes: Development fixtures; exactly one attempt per task per arm, not held-out qualification.
Both arms use the same frozen binary; only thinkingCycleGuard differs.
Raw file content/path/type and directory deltas include caches; metadata/timestamps/permissions are not compared.
Provider usage is known only where terminal observations supply it; interrupted work may lack receipts.
Timing is observational; no speed or general reliability claim from n=1 per task.

Length-stop output tokens cannot be assigned to thinking, tool arguments or visible output from token totals alone. The control log second length stop exposes only 902 thinking characters and no accepted tool/visible response; its remaining output cause is unobserved, not an inferred argument or thinking loop.
